stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 109 km apart and travel towards each other at 54 km/h and 51 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 54 + 51 = 105$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{109}{105} = 1.04$ hours.
